library.title: ControlsBench Core
library.testedBuildEnvironment: CODESYS 3.5.22.30, CODESYS V3.5 SP22 Patch 3, File-Based Storage 1.0.0.0

versioning.machineMap: per map: mapVersion, schemaId and tapSchemaId wire fingerprints, engineeringVersion; see mappings/generated/*.manifest.json
versioning.releasePolicy: immutable promoted builds; older builds and evidence are preserved and re-audited

observation.timing: SourceCycle and SourceTimeUs are PLC platform monotonic values of the session cycle; workstation receipt time is added by the reader and kept separate
observation.clock: unsynchronised to wall time; alignment only within one BootIdentity and DomainId; no cross-task or cross-domain simultaneity claim
observation.gaps: FrameSequence counts publications; MissedCycles and RepeatedCycles count source cycles without, or with more than one, frame
observation.resources: fixed size (about 2.4 KB frame), one copy per call, no allocation, no blocking on any transport; Enable=FALSE skips the copy
observation.coherence: same PublicationRevision seqlock as FB_CB_OutputCapture; requires a qualified ordered fresh-read transport policy
observation.writes: none; taps and frames are read-only by construction

capabilityStatuses.implemented: delivered and exercised by executed host-side checks or a CODESYS conversion/compile round trip in this lane
capabilityStatuses.compiled-only: PLC source compiled into the library and both consumers with zero errors and warnings; never executed
capabilityStatuses.runtime-validated: executed on a PLC runtime with retained evidence; no library capability has this status yet
capabilityStatuses.planned: accepted requirement with a reserved extension point or recorded limitation and an acceptance gate
capabilityStatuses.unsupported: deliberately not provided by this profile; rejected or absent, never emulated

capabilities.summary: Validate a machine map, reject unsupported native types, allocate channels, compute wire fingerprints and generate typed ST wrappers and a manifest
capabilities.gate: G-RT-1 executes generated wrappers on a target; G-DEP-1 binds a manifest to a transport

capabilities.summary: Headless build from a recorded commit, immutable promotion, Git-based source and artifact audit of every build
capabilities.gate: Run the audit in CI for every change; G-REL-1 for a release

capabilities.summary: A copy of the built library converts to CODESYS File-Based Storage, reopens with fbs.open, matches Git source text, compiles without caches and rebuilds both consumers
capabilities.gate: G-FBS-2 makes the native project the edited source for the next version

capabilities.summary: Cold start selects hardware unchanged; exit always restores it
Entry gives complete configured input authority at raw zero; staged data never applies
Two slots, write-last RequestedSequence, one revision across all banks
capabilities.gate: G-RT-1, then G-DEP-1 repeats M2-class coherence over a real transport

capabilities.summary: Invalid, incomplete, mismatched, duplicate, stale, skipped, epoch and idle requests with latched consumed acknowledgement and separate counters
Native width per channel, REAL non-finite policy, zero in unconfigured channels; rejection names bank and index
Elapsed-microsecond staleness; image and simulation held; heartbeat alone publishes nothing
capabilities.gate: G-RT-1, then G-DEP-1 repeats M5-class loss cases

capabilities.summary: Session reset, Simulation Reset, Exit Simulation and local Reinitialize stay distinct; machine Reset is never issued
Boot identity, backward clock or configuration change latches ReconfigureRequired and refuses requests
Authentic commands always observed; explicit per-channel suppression with substitute values changes only the physical sink and reports applied masks
Commands captured after the application with the consumed input revision and an odd/even publication revision
capabilities.gate: G-RT-1, then G-ACQ-1 qualifies the transport read policy

capabilities.summary: Instances own all state; two or more domains with distinct maps, timeouts and schemas

Extension point: one bounded frame per cycle with raw hardware, selected inputs, authentic commands, physical sink, suppression masks, taps, boot/domain/cycle/time and quality; needs no simulation authority
FrameSequence, MissedCycles and RepeatedCycles expose source-side gaps and integration errors
Extension point: map-declared read-only taps for PID setpoint, process variable, output and mode under their own TapSchemaId
Workstation reader that records frames with receipt time, requested and achieved rate, decimation and preserved gaps
Versioned recording header and frame records; draft schema reserved, no writer or reader exists
Possible later source-side ring buffer if measurements show polling misses source dynamics; distinct from stimulus playback
PID tuning, filtering and signal-processing tools that consume recordings through their own explicit capabilities
Execute the 46-case harness on a separate test target
Measured per-cycle cost of session, taps, capture and observation on a real task
A new-identity consumer replaces the demo's integrated interceptor after regression
Other PLC platforms implementing the common standard natively
No PID excitation, gain write or controller change follows from observation or recording permission; a later tool needs its own explicit capability and tests
64-bit, time, string and structured fields are rejected by the map validator; a later profile is required
Each domain belongs to one task; no simultaneity across tasks or domains is claimed
Not wire-compatible with the frozen M8 GVL_BenchWrite/GVL_BenchRead adapter map
No PLC-side pattern player; simulation runs on the workstation
